gloss: to become old enough to understand things

definitions.gloss: to reach the age of awareness (as a child)
definitions.explanation: For a young child to begin to understand the world and to form lasting memories; used to date one's earliest memories or a lifelong habit.

examples.japanese: {物心|ものごころ}がついた⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いていた→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I've been drawing since I was old enough to remember.

examples.japanese: {物心|ものごころ}がつく⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: My father died before I was old enough to understand.

examples.japanese: {物心|ものごころ}ついたとき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいた→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: By the time I was aware of things, we were already living in this house in Tokyo.

notes:
Almost always in a time clause: {物心|ものごころ}がついた⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧ / とき (when I became aware), {物心|ものごころ}がついて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (ever since), {物心|ものごころ}がつく⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (before). The ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ is often dropped: {物心|ものごころ}ついた⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→頃：32850_koro⟧: in early childhood; a plain time phrase, without the idea of awareness
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: as far back as I can remember
